baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb أَكْثَرُوا governs ٱلْفَسَادَ, while فِيهَا locates the produced condition inside a shared domain.
baseline_models.mechanism: Agentive increase acts on a state of lost soundness: repeated or enlarged acts do not merely add offenses but raise the domain's level of dysfunction.

activation_trace.role: Supplies increase in number or amount and making something plentiful; it makes the verb an amplifier.
Supplies departure from soundness and balance; it identifies the condition being amplified.

changed_reading.after: They made breakdown proliferate within the place until unsoundness became a condition of the whole domain.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَكْثَرُوا can activate not only sheer quantity but the focus inventory's rivalry-through-number branch, with ٱلْفَسَادَ as its result.
baseline_models.mechanism: If increase is socially competitive, each agent or regime proves dominance by outscaling others; corruption becomes an escalation dynamic rather than an accidental sum.

activation_trace.role: Supplies outnumbering and rivalry in abundance; it turns multiplication into competitive escalation.
Supplies the loss of viable order that competitive escalation produces.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a large quantity of wrongdoing.
changed_reading.after: The verse also permits a regime in which actors compete through excess, making corruption outgrow every corrective restraint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins a gathering branch of ك ث ر to the singular mass noun ٱلْفَسَادَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Many failures gather and interlock until they operate as one clustered condition; quantity changes the organization of damage, not only its count.

activation_trace.role: Supplies clustering or gathering together; it organizes separate acts into a connected mass.
Supplies systemic unsoundness; it names the emergent state of the cluster.

changed_reading.before: Numerous corrupt acts occurred in the place.
changed_reading.after: Separate corruptions accumulated into an interdependent failure-system inside the place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split inventory permits night-motion or coursing and hidden interiority to cooperate: multiplied فساد becomes a concealed current moving through the domain rather than a static pile of acts.

activation_trace.role: Supplies proliferation; it gives the concealed current repeated reach.
Supplies the spreading loss of soundness to which the current leads.
Supplies coursing or flowing movement; it makes corruption mobile within the domain.
The non-dominant split supplies concealment in an interior; it makes the movement difficult to detect.

structural_cues: 89:4 places movement inside night, and 89:2 has already pluralized nights, giving concealment both motion and recurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nocturnal motion or current and, through the non-dominant split mapping, hidden interiority; I infer covert circulation of the increased فساد. A live alternative keeps يَسْرِ as temporal passage only, with no clandestine social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Corruption became numerous in a place.
changed_reading.after: Corruption multiplied by circulating through the place's hidden interiors, spreading before it became publicly legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: A bounded land with a restraining barrier is subjected to limit-crossing force figured as overflowing water; فِيهَا then marks the container whose internal balance is saturated and breached.

activation_trace.role: Supplies quantitative growth; it turns a breach into sustained saturation.
Supplies departure from balance; it names the condition left inside the breached domain.
Supplies prevention and enclosure; it functions as the limit that should contain action.
Supplies a delimited tract of earth; it makes the pronoun's place a civic-territorial container.
Supplies rising water and sweeping force; it gives transgression a physical overflow mechanism.

structural_cues: The shared locative pattern فِى ٱلْبِلَادِ in 89:11 and فِيهَا in 89:12 makes the land the receiving interior.
The sequence moves from restraint in 89:5 to overflow in 89:11 and multiplied imbalance in 89:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enclosure, bounded land, and sweeping overflow; I infer that repeated limit-crossing saturates a civic ecology until it loses balance. The live alternative is a purely juridical sequence of transgression and sin without a spatial-pressure model.

changed_reading.before: They did many bad things in the lands.
changed_reading.after: They drove a bounded social-land system past its containing limits, making imbalance overflow and occupy its interior.

context_deltas.mechanism: Supports, measured making, penetrative rock-cutting, resistant substrate, and fixed stakes form a chain of engineered capacity. Such capacity can multiply فساد by embedding domination in durable structures rather than leaving it at the level of individual acts.

activation_trace.role: Supplies scaling; it makes technical capacity a multiplier rather than a neutral possession.
Supplies structural loss of soundness as the outcome of scaled power.
Supplies load-bearing support; it introduces built structures that can carry and reproduce power.
Supplies measuring and proportioning; it frames exceptional construction as designed capacity.
Supplies a penetrating cut; it turns hard landscape into material worked by organized force.
Supplies massive hardness; it marks the resistant substrate overcome by that force.
Supplies stake-like fixity; it lets coercive power appear anchored and durable.

structural_cues: 89:7-10 moves through pillars, unprecedented making, rock-cutting, and stakes before naming overflow and multiplied corruption.
The branchless ك ي ف at 89:6 is used only as a structural manner-question that invites attention to how the power operated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of support, design, cutting, hardness, and fixation; I infer that technical achievements become channels that scale domination. A live alternative treats the structures only as emblems of might, with no claim that building or excavation is itself corrupt.

changed_reading.before: Powerful peoples happened to commit many corrupt acts.
changed_reading.after: Their organized material capacity let corruption become infrastructural, durable, and reproducible across the land.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repair, nurture, and completion branch surrounding the focus makes multiplied فساد readable as organized anti-repair: the agents increase whatever prevents the domain from reaching sound completion.

activation_trace.role: Supplies deliberate increase; it gives anti-repair a productive, scaling action.
Supplies the opposite of soundness and repair; it is the damaged trajectory being cultivated.
Supplies repair, nurture, and completion; it provides the immediate contrast to multiplied فساد.

structural_cues: The ر ب ب cue recurs before and after the focus at 89:6, 89:13, and 89:14, enclosing the agents' multiplication within a contrasting governance frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies فساد as unsoundness and ر ب ب as repair or completion; I infer a reversal in which the agents systematically cultivate non-repair. The live alternative activates only sovereignty in ر ب ب and leaves the focus as an ordinary report of corruption.

changed_reading.before: They increased damage under a sovereign's watch.
changed_reading.after: They practiced a counter-cultivation, scaling the forces that keep a society from becoming sound or complete.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence resolves abstract فساد into a distributive feedback loop: people sever care for the unprotected, fail to feed others, absorb transferred wealth, gather it without distinction, and pursue accumulation to fullness.

activation_trace.role: Supplies accumulation and increase; it links the social sequence to the focus's multiplication.
Supplies loss of social balance as the cumulative result.
Supplies severance from a guardian; it identifies a person exposed when care is withdrawn.
Supplies feeding another; its negated social mobilization marks blocked outward provision.
Supplies consuming or seizing wealth; it turns possession into an absorptive process.
Supplies transfer from predecessor to heir; it locates what the absorptive process takes over.
Supplies collecting dispersed things; it makes appropriation indiscriminately aggregative.
Supplies acquiring and multiplying wealth; it names the object around which accumulation organizes.
Supplies gathering in abundance until fullness; it echoes and intensifies the focus's increase.

structural_cues: 89:17-20 alternates failed outward care with intensive object repetition in eating and loving, then culminates in جَمًّا.
The movement from an unguarded person to food, inheritance, and amassed wealth supplies a directional map of extraction and deprivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies care-severance, feeding, wealth-consumption, inheritance transfer, and gathering to fullness; I infer that the sequence exemplifies how فساد is socially reproduced. A live alternative reads 89:17-20 as a new universal critique rather than a specification of the historical mechanism in 89:12.

changed_reading.before: The historical peoples spread unspecified corruption.
changed_reading.after: They multiplied a distributive disorder in which wealth is gathered inward while dignity, guardianship, and nourishment fail to move outward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same clustering that made فساد systemic acquires a threshold: crowding and accumulation reverse into demolition and leveling of the ground that held the system.

activation_trace.role: Supplies clustered accumulation; it gives the corruption a density capable of reaching a threshold.
Supplies systemic loss of balance; it is the unstable state that precedes collapse.
Supplies crowding and accumulation; it echoes the focus's gathered excess at the point of reversal.
Supplies pounding or demolition until level; it converts accumulated height and density into flattening.
Supplies the lower ground opposed to height; it is the final plane to which the corrupted domain is reduced.

structural_cues: The triple occurrence of د ك ك in 89:21 and the doubled verbal-noun pattern stage leveling as repeated, exhaustive action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both accumulation and leveling under one later root; I infer a threshold reversal from piled corruption to the collapse of its supporting terrain. The live alternative treats the leveling as an independent cosmic event with no causal morphology shared with the focus.

changed_reading.before: More corruption simply means a larger amount of damage.
changed_reading.after: Multiplication drives corruption toward a density threshold at which the elevated system and its ground are forcibly leveled.

context_deltas.mechanism: Increase becomes temporal compounding: each corrupt choice displaces an act that could have been sent ahead as life-giving benefit, while recognition arrives only after the sequence has become irreversible.

activation_trace.role: Supplies repeated increase; it lets corruption compound across decisions and time.
Supplies the deteriorated state recognized at the end of the accumulation.
Supplies recovery after forgetting; it makes the damage fully legible only in retrospect.
Supplies advancing something ahead; it identifies the foregone counter-action.
Supplies benefit and good as life; it defines what the displaced advance could have served.

structural_cues: The repeated يَوْمَئِذٍ in 89:23 is followed by retrospective speech in 89:24, staging recognition after the actionable interval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies retrospective remembering, advancing ahead, and life as benefit; I infer that every increment of فساد also accumulates lost opportunity for repair. A live alternative confines these cues to final regret and does not project temporal path-dependence back into أَكْثَرُوا.

changed_reading.before: They increased corruption at one historical moment.
changed_reading.after: They compounded corruption over time by repeatedly replacing life-giving advance with choices whose full damage became visible too late.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending supplies an inverse mode of inhabiting: calm return, mutual acceptance, entry into a serving community, and entry into a sheltered garden answer the earlier occupation of a land by multiplied imbalance.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the earlier proliferation that filled a domain with damage.
Supplies loss of soundness; it provides the negative state reversed by the ending.
Supplies settled calm; it reverses the instability of a domain driven out of balance.
Supplies turning back from a wrong or course; it makes repair directional rather than merely subtractive.
Supplies reciprocal acceptance; it replaces rivalry with a mutually viable relation.
Supplies entry into an interior; it creates a positive counterpart to the focus's corrupted inside.
Supplies humble service and obedience; it identifies the social relation entered.
Supplies a garden sheltered by vegetation; it gives repaired inhabitation a protected ecology.

structural_cues: The ending shifts from فِيهَا in a corrupted territorial sequence to two commands of entry in 89:29-30.
The paired participles in 89:28 make acceptance reciprocal rather than a one-sided possession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calm, corrective return, reciprocal acceptance, service, and sheltered entry; I infer that these form an inverse ecology of the focus's corrupted interior. A live alternative reads the ending solely as consolation and reward, without making it a structural counter-reading of 89:12.

changed_reading.before: The verse condemns what people did inside a land.
changed_reading.after: The verse also marks a corrupted mode of inhabiting, later countered by return and entry into a calm, reciprocal, protected belonging.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads 89:13 backward through the non-obvious mixing branch of س و ط; it remains anchored in the focus's clustering and فساد, but downstream prose should present it as a compositional analogy, not a lexical gloss of either corruption or punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The clustered increase of أَكْثَرُوا ٱلْفَسَادَ can be tested against the immediately following poured, mixed punitive image.

activation_trace.role: Supplies gathering into a cluster; it permits corruption to be composite rather than homogeneous.
Supplies the unsound result shared by the heterogeneous components.
Supplies pouring or discharge; it gives the response a continuous delivered form.
Supplies mixing one thing with another; it mirrors corruption as an accumulated composite.
Supplies painful penalty; it fixes the mixed discharge as punitive rather than neutral.

changed_reading.before: Corruption is one undifferentiated excess answered by punishment.
changed_reading.after: They gathered heterogeneous corruptions into one failed system, and the next ayah imagistically answers that composite with a poured mixture of penalty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The dust image is materially distant from the surface syntax, but it is a supplied branch of the focus verb and remains joined to فساد as loss of balance; prose should qualify this as a sensory model of spread and obscuration, never as the word's direct translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root ك ث ر itself supplies a roiling-dust branch, while فِيهَا gives that disturbed material a place to fill.

activation_trace.role: Supplies abundant dust rising and roiling; it models multiplication as turbulent spread that also obscures.
Supplies departure from balance; it makes the turbulence damaging rather than merely atmospheric.
Supplies a sudden surge of much; it gives the roiling increase a rupture-like onset.

changed_reading.after: Corruption surged like a roiling cloud, filling the domain, spreading through motion, and obscuring the conditions needed for correction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because a later دخول branch explicitly carries hidden فساد and is projected back onto فِيهَا; the focus noun and locative keep it anchored, but downstream prose should label it an inside-versus-entry analogy rather than claim that 89:12 names infiltration.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The construction فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ places corruption in an interior, allowing the later hidden-contaminant branch of entry to sharpen how that interior can fail.

activation_trace.role: Supplies multiplication; it lets an internal defect reproduce through the host domain.
Supplies internal loss of soundness as the contaminant's effect.
Supplies corruption hidden inside; it recasts the focus's locative as embedded contamination.

changed_reading.before: Corruption is visible misconduct occurring within a territory.
changed_reading.after: Corruption may also be an embedded defect multiplied inside institutions or relations until the containing domain itself becomes unsound.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from generic excess to a causal pressure model: transgression overflows a bounded land and proliferates imbalance through its interior.
The monuments and rock-work made a distinct infrastructural reading possible, while 89:17-20 supplied a stronger distributive mechanism of inward accumulation and failed outward care.
Later leveling, retrospective memory, and reparative re-entry added threshold, temporal, and inverse-inhabitation readings without displacing the earlier models.
summary.what_was_special: The same small focus inventory supported quantity, rivalry, clustering, and roiling spread. Split س ر ي then activated a covert-current reading, while the later social and entry sequences converted the terse focus into several coexisting material, institutional, temporal, and interior mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The engineered structures may be mechanisms that scale domination or only emblems of already-existing power.
The care, inheritance, and wealth sequence may directly unpack the earlier فساد or may analogize it for a later audience.
The hidden-interiority reading relies on a non-dominant split mapping of س ر ي and should remain exploratory beside the ordinary night-motion reading.
The restorative ending may structurally invert the corrupted interior without being a direct semantic explanation of 89:12.
